raw_segments.text: She did confess she had for you a mortal mineral, which, being took, should by the minute feed
on life and lingering by inches waste you.
In which time she purposed by watching, weeping, tendence, kissing to orkum you with her show,
and in time when she had fitted you with her craft to work her son into T.H., adoption
But failing of her end by his strange absence grew shameless desperate, opened, in despite
of heaven and men, her purposes, repented the evils she hatched were not affected.
